title: Prices
text: Skin fade £18. Cut and style £16. Beard trim £10. Cut and beard together £24. Under 12s £12. We take card and cash. No extra charge for requesting a specific barber.

title: Opening hours
text: Monday to Friday 9am to 7pm. Saturday 8am to 6pm. Closed Sunday. The last appointment of the day is 30 minutes before closing time.

title: Booking and walk-ins
text: Book online at northsidebarbers.co.uk/book or call 0161 496 0000. Walk-ins are welcome but Thursday to Saturday are busy, so booking ahead is recommended.

title: Location and parking
text: 42 Bury New Road, Manchester M8 8EE, two minutes from the tram stop. Free street parking after 6pm and a pay-and-display car park directly opposite the shop.

title: Cancellations
text: Cancel or reschedule free of charge up to 4 hours before the appointment using the link in the confirmation text. Within 4 hours we charge 50% of the service price because the slot usually cannot be refilled.

title: The team
text: Four barbers work in the shop: Sam, Aaron, Dee and Josh. Customers can request a specific barber when booking online at no extra cost.

title: Children
text: Children's haircuts are welcome. Under 12s are £12. Mornings are quieter and usually easier for younger children.

title: Gift vouchers
text: Gift vouchers are available in £10, £25 and £50 amounts, bought in the shop or over the phone. Valid for 12 months from purchase.

title: Group and wedding bookings
text: Group and wedding bookings are available, usually arranged before opening hours so the group has the whole shop. Call 0161 496 0000 to arrange.

title: Contact
text: Phone 0161 496 0000 or email hello@northsidebarbers.co.uk. The phone is answered during opening hours.
